capture_boundary.meaning: Single outbound choke point: every handler result (heartbeats, campaign votes, append responses, proposal broadcasts) is delivered here via transport.Send; the controller wraps this seam.

pending_store.meaning: map[uint64]CapturedMessage guarded by controller.mu; nextID/nextSeq monotonic counters preserve capture order.

entrypoint.meaning: Test-mode capture entry: clones the outbound message, stores a stable snapshot in the pending store with an incrementing ID/CaptureSequence, and returns nil without invoking the wrapped transport.

message_capture.copy_strategy: Message.Clone() deep copy taken at Send entry (Entry.Data copied via append([]byte(nil), ...)); ListPending returns further independent copies (CapturedMessage.copy); Inject passes another fresh clone.
message_capture.production_mode: None in v0.1: the wrapped Transport is retained but never invoked (test-mode suppression only).
message_capture.test_mode: NewMessageController(Transport) creates an active test-mode controller; capture and suppression begin immediately after construction with no enable/disable toggle.
notes: Capture happens before the original send: Send never calls the wrapped Transport, so a captured message cannot continue automatically along the original path.
No scheduling policy: the pending store is a map keyed by monotonically increasing message IDs; capture order is preserved by CaptureSequence.
Send/capture may run concurrently with controller operations: Send takes only the pending-store mutex (controller.mu), never the operation mutex (controller.opMu).
Register(node) is an additive seam that records injection targets; it does not alter capture behavior.
Additive implementation: only message_controller.go and message_controller_test.go were added; node.go, message.go, transport.go, and node_test.go are unchanged.

pending_store.meaning: Pending store from which Inject consumes the selected message after successful delivery; guarded by controller.mu.

entrypoint.meaning: Normal protocol input boundary: validates message.To == node.id, clones on entry, processes under the node mutex, and emits responses synchronously.

message_injection.copy_strategy: A fresh Message.Clone() is passed to target.Step; the pending snapshot is never mutated and delivery content matches the captured message exactly.
message_injection.test_mode: Injection enters the recorded target's normal protocol input boundary (Node.Step) with an unmodified clone of the captured message.
notes: Inject selects by MessageID, resolves the target from the recorded To field (controller.nodes), and delivers through the recorded target's Node.Step; the delivered message retains the recorded To.
The selected message is consumed (deleted from the pending store) only after target.Step returns nil; on any delivery error (e.g. ErrPaused) the message remains pending.
Inject and ClearPending are serialized by an operation mutex held across lookup, delivery, and consumption; no IN_FLIGHT state is used (v0.1 serialization).
Concurrent Inject calls for the same MessageID yield exactly one success; the others fail with ErrUnknownMessageID.
Errors are returned via errors.Is-compatible wrapping (ErrUnknownMessageID, ErrUnknownTargetNode, or the underlying Step error).
Additive implementation: only message_controller.go and message_controller_test.go were added; protocol logic and existing tests are unchanged.
